name: gamebox
summary: 🕹️ Apple-Native Win32 Game Runtime — "맥에서 윈도우 게임 돌리는 통역기". Run Windows PE games natively on macOS / Apple Silicon via a hexa-only stack: PE loader + Win32 API shim + DirectX→Metal, with per-game launch tracks. Hexa-only · Wine 0 · D3DMetal-pinned · own1-posture · skeleton-tier. Forensic verdict (2026-05-05): SKELETON_TIER_100PCT_WIN32_VALIDATED_MANJEOM_0 (honest C3 — 435/435 Win32 fn coverage + 18+ perf families at 100% manjeom, but validated_manjeom=0: no real game frames evidenced).
note: This JSON tree is the architecture SSOT (update-in-place, NOT append-only). Human viewer = ARCHITECTURE.html via `python3 serve.py`. History/decisions → CHANGELOG.md; governance → CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.tape; per-track evidence → .roadmap.<game> + .checkpoint.<x> + state/markers/ + .verdicts/. Migrated from the retired `harness domain` machinery (DOMAINS.tape roster + domains/*.md snapshots + domains/*.log.md step logs) on 2026-06-18 — DOMAINS.tape scrubbed, domain snapshots folded here, domain step logs folded into CHANGELOG.md.

meta.code_layout: lib/loader/ (pe_* · win32_* · i386_* · pe_d3d* · ipc_*) · lib/perf/ (c_* per-game/perf tracks · 242 c_*.hexa across 104 families) · native/ (C helpers + i386_decode.hexa port) · .roadmap.<game> (15 SSOT) · .checkpoint.<x> (7) · state/markers/ (per-cycle/per-track run markers) · .verdicts/ (RUNEQ/port verdicts)
meta.migrated_from: harness `domain` machinery (DOMAINS.tape + domains/*.md + domains/*.log.md) retired 2026-06-18 → ARCHITECTURE.json tree SSOT + ARCHITECTURE.html viewer (c4 standard)

children.name: 🧱 메인구조 — engine subsystems
children.summary: The 6 core engine subsystems the per-game tracks stand on. All subsystem code is present (skeleton-tier); per-game domains list them as prerequisites.

children.name: GAMEBOX-LOADER — "PE 적재기"
children.summary: hexa-only PE loader: map PE32/PE32+ images, i386/x64 decode, IAT resolve, base relocations, SEH chains, TLS callbacks, MSVC CRT init — Wine=0 (no Wine dependency). Open: PE32/PE32+ section mapper + reloc applier (real mmap); i386+x64 decode + calling-convention xlate to arm64; IAT resolve (direct/forwarder/delay-load/hint) real binding; SEH x64 .pdata unwinder + i386 FS:[0] chain; TLS callback dispatch + MSVC CRT bring-up.

children.name: GAMEBOX-WIN32 — "윈도우 API 통역"
children.summary: hexa-native Win32 API shim across ~14 DLLs (kernel32/user32/gdi32/ntdll/advapi32/winsock/ole32/…) — real implementations over stubs, Wine=0. 435/435 skeleton-tier fn coverage across 32 PE_core modules. Open: kernel32 stage1→5 real; user32+gdi32 tier1 real; ntdll native API real; advapi32/crypt32/ole32/oleaut32/shell32 tier1; winsock ws2_32 + IOCP/overlapped/select.

children.name: GAMEBOX-GFX — "그래픽 변환기"
children.summary: DirectX → Metal translation: D3D11 + D3D12 command/resource/pipeline mapped to Metal, DXGI swapchain present, DXBC/DXIL→AIR shader cross-compile. Open: D3D11 real path → Metal; D3D12 real path (queue/list, descriptor heap, fence, present); DXGI factory+swapchain+router; shader xlate DXBC/DXIL→AIR + SV mapping; advanced DXR raytracing / mesh shader / compute dispatch.

children.name: GAMEBOX-NET — "네트워크 프로토콜"
children.summary: Networking/IPC protocol layer: winsock/IOCP, IPC (mach port/xpc/named pipe/shared mem), TLS (schannel/apple-network), OAuth, and TACT/NGDP/CASC content delivery primitives shared by launchers. Open: winsock ws2_32 + IOCP/overlapped/select + iphlpapi; IPC matrix (mach/xpc/unix socket/named pipe/shared mem/tcp loopback); TLS schannel + apple-network; OAuth device/PKCE + redirect proxy; TACT/NGDP/CASC parser + CDN chunk assemble/dedup/resume.

children.name: GAMEBOX-PERF — "성능 계기판"
children.summary: Performance + telemetry + presentation: FPS overlay (Metal-composed), frame pacing, display modes (fullscreen/PIP/dpi), Metal optimization tracks, per-session aggregation. 18+ perf families at 100% manjeom. Open: FPS overlay (metal compose + history graph + hotkey + aggregator); adaptive frame pacing + frametime histogram; display modes (fullscreen-exclusive Metal/PIP/dpi/focus/menubar); Metal opt (pipeline archive, private-heap prewarm, residency coalesce, simdgroup reduce); session aggregator + roofline/thermal/vram forecast.

children.name: GAMEBOX-NATIVE — "C 받침대"
children.summary: Thin native C helper layer the hexa stack calls into: i386 instruction decode, PE parse, PE→Mach-O shim — built with entitlements for JIT/mmap. Open: i386_decode.c decode helper + test; pe_parse.c header/section/import parse; pe_to_macho_shim.c PE→Mach-O bridge; build.sh + entitlements.plist (JIT/mmap/weak-link Metal).

children.name: C-PORT — "native C → hexa 이식"
children.summary: Drive gamebox's native x86-decoder / PE-shim C to hexa-native wherever no OS-ABI dependency forces C; RUNEQ-gated (byte-identical output vs the C baseline). Irreducible FFI/loader syscalls stay C. Live scope: native/*.c — 4 files, 869 LOC, classified Tier A (PORTABLE 437) / Tier B (TEST harness 113) / Tier C (IRREDUCIBLE FFI/platform 319). Open: full Tier-A port of i386_decode_one + opcode dispatch + i386_format_insn (RUNEQ over real PE .text corpus); pe_parse.c split (hexa pe_parse_buf core + thin C/FFI file-map ingress); Tier-B retire i386_decode_test.c at parity; Tier-C documented-stay pe_to_macho_shim.c MAP_JIT/mprotect.
children.note: M1 inventory+classify (.verdicts/c-port/INVENTORY.txt). M2 decode_modrm_disp + i386_reg32_name → hexa, RUNEQ 768/768 byte-identical (.verdicts/c-port/M2-decode_modrm_disp.txt). M3 leaf batch decode_prefixes + i386_op_name + rd_s32/rd_s16 → hexa, RUNEQ 1069/1069 byte-identical, sha256 8e6acbb8 (.verdicts/c-port/M3-*.txt).

children.name: 🚀 런처/플랫폼 — launchers

children.name: GAMEBOX-BNET — "배틀넷 런처"
children.summary: Battle.net launcher/platform bring-up: agent IPC, install/setup path, download (TACT/NGDP/CASC), OAuth token, cold→warm launch orchestration for D2R/D4/CS2/SC2. Consumers: D2R · D4 · CS2. Landed: agent IPC + HTTP REST 4-verb + agent SD forging; setup/install + static-CRT path; TACT/NGDP/CASC download + CDN mirror; OAuth token + apple-network HTTP; real launch orchestrator → D2R offline+online checkpoints (online honest-freeze where Warden/anti-cheat blocks). Open: extend launch path to D4 / CS2.
children.note: D2R launch path is checkpoint-proven (.checkpoint.d2r_battlenet_offline_play + .checkpoint.d2r_battlenet_online_play), so BNET is non-blocking for D2R bring-up. .roadmap.battlenet.

children.name: GAMEBOX-PURPLE — "퍼플 런처"
children.summary: plaync PURPLE launcher/platform for Lineage M/W: 2FA TOTP, plaync OAuth proxy, WebView2 warm, .NET CLR probe, Android-emulation layer for mobile titles. Consumers: LINEAGE-M · LINEAGE-W (launch via PURPLE, both checkpoint-proven). Also LINEAGE-CLASSIC depends on PURPLE for DOWNLOAD/INSTALL only (sole acquisition channel); Classic runtime is native ("no Purple shell"), so PURPLE does not gate Classic execution. Landed: plaync OAuth proxy + 2FA TOTP proxy; WebView2 warm + .NET CLR probe; Android emulation layer track; offline shim → Lineage M/W purple checkpoints.

Landed: R28 loader track + native first-frame (12 markers); local first-frame checkpoint (LOCAL RENDER only, NOT online); drift resolution track bv. Open: ONLINE login/realm path → in-world (the real playable gate).
children.note: Launches/installs via GAMEBOX-PURPLE (download only); runtime native. PLAYABLE GATE = GameGuard (INCA Internet) kernel anti-cheat → retired_intentional / honest-freeze (docs/LINEAGE_CLASSIC_R28_MANJEOM_REVIEW.md). .checkpoint.lineage_classic_r28_play.

children.name: 🛫 GAMEBOX-LAUNCHPAD+ — sprint meta ("두 게임 빠른 출시대")
children.summary: Focused sprint meta-domain (`+` = composition) over the two near-ready titles: get GAMEBOX-D2R + GAMEBOX-LINEAGE-CLASSIC to PLAYABLE ("도달") as fast as possible. DONE = both titles flipped to playable in their own domains. Targets → D2R (prereqs ✅ green · offline+online checkpoint; remaining: gameplay loop · online=Warden freeze) + LINEAGE-CLASSIC (ONLINE MMO · local first-frame ✅ · online play 🔲; remaining: server login→realm→in-world · GameGuard gate · download=PURPLE deferred). children.note: "도달(playable)" bar = boot → title → character/login → online server/realm → in-world controllable loop, held for a smoke session, captured as a per-title checkpoint. BOTH titles are ONLINE — full in-world online play is gated by kernel anti-cheat honest-freeze (D2R=Warden · Classic=GameGuard) and may be a hard stop, recorded honestly. Targets GAMEBOX-D2R + GAMEBOX-LINEAGE-CLASSIC.
